description: Sage S2.1 Flash (Shanghai AI Laboratory's model on the GLM-5.3-Flash architecture) on four DGX Sparks with KindlingAI's gr8, a from-scratch CUDA inference engine (no vLLM, PyTorch or NCCL at serve time), at tensor parallel 4 over the ConnectX fabric. The weights are KindlingAI's exlr8 K4 release (every routed and shared expert at 4 bits a weight), int4 KV, eight requests at once (SESS=8) sharing a 262,208-token KV pool, requests up to 262,144 tokens, bit-exact shared-waterfill MTP=2 drafting and a prompt cache on disk, text only by default. The kit (kindlingai/sage-s2.1-flash-exlr8-4x-spark at 1f106277) publishes no image, so the recipe follows its own image path: gr8's published image of the kit's gr8 commit ca7e8745 plus the kit's knobs, entrypoint and prompt-cache file, with a placement wrapper that reads the platform's VONK_* environment and uses the release in place from the read-only model mounts. Options: speed, long context (a 2,097,152-token pool, requests up to 1,048,576 tokens, context-parallel KV, experimental upstream) or quality (strict MTP=1); and image input (the creator's untested opt-in). Creator claims, unmeasured here: 88.0 tok/s for one request writing code, 2,999 tok/s prefill at 8K, 79.5 / 106.7 / 127.5 / 162.0 tok/s aggregate at 1 / 2 / 4 / 8 streams, 46.5-48.2 GiB free a box with long context. Each box mounts the whole release less the other ranks' index slices (about 165 GB), where the creator's launcher range-fetches about 47 GB from Hugging Face. The model always thinks: a request that turns thinking off gets the template's lowest effort with the reasoning withheld, and a small max_tokens can end inside the thinking. Licence, for information: MIT.
title: Sage S2.1 Flash EXLR8 gr8 four Sparks
